cohort: 112,403 women who underwent routine obstetric ultrasound during 18 to 22 weeks of pregnancy in 14 provinces and 39 different hospitals in China in 2011
finding: Pregnant women with uterine fibroids are at increased risk for cesarean delivery, breech presentation and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: The size of uterine fibroids and location in uterus had an important effect on the mode of delivery.
